dialogues.speaker: Ferrylady
dialogues.text: In Liyue it's generally not customary for people to speak to those of us from Wangsheng Funeral Parlor.

dialogues.speaker: Ferrylady
dialogues.text: Therefore... you must be outlanders. Or are you... something else?

choices.text: You're right, we're not from here.

response.speaker: Ferrylady
response.text: I serve the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. Come to think of it, I haven't spoken to anyone that isn't from there in a long time.

response.speaker: Ferrylady
response.text: Even when I'm working, I don't speak to the family of those who have passed out of respect for the old customs.

response.speaker: Ferrylady
response.text: When night falls, the family leaves out what is necessary and a few things to eat, and then retire to their rooms where they shut the doors tight. I then go about my business silently, preparing the ashes before taking my leave.

response.speaker: Ferrylady
response.text: So for someone to speak to me, especially at night, is nigh on unheard of. Please forgive me, I was not ignoring you intentionally.

response.speaker: Ferrylady
response.text: I stare death straight in the eye when others dare not.

response.speaker: Ferrylady
response.text: I have nothing to do with what has led you here.

response.speaker: Ferrylady
response.text: I have nothing to do with where you shall go.

response.speaker: Ferrylady
response.text: Go, lost soul. Into the light.
